# SEO Backlinks

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): it analyses a site's backlink profile in 7 sections and scores it, working alone as an analysis framework with strict no-score-without-data gates. At use, through the family's bundled tools (outside this folder), it calls Common Crawl and a verification crawler for free, the user's own Moz/Bing Webmaster/Keywords Everywhere keys when configured, and the paid DataForSEO extension when installed, fetching the target's linking pages and competitor data over the network. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
